design: PPO Order Fulfilment & Customer Delivery r01

results.name: The seed fixture validates and every declared collection invariant holds
Company grants isolate records from search, counts, snapshots and projections
Commercial values never enter a projection for a role without the commercial grant
Warehouse scope limits the availability view without inventing a quantity
A partial observation is unknown, not zero, and cannot support a reservation
Quarantined stock is physically present but never usable
An internally inconsistent source value is preserved and excluded, not corrected
An unresolved unit basis is never summed and never satisfies a differing unit
Incoming supply is promised, not usable
The register condition and blockers describe the Northbank shortage exactly
Requested, confirmed and expected dates are separate values with their own versions
Reservation binds evidenced usable stock and records a confirmed source reference
Double allocation against the same evidenced quantity is refused, not netted to a negative
Competing demand against one observation lets exactly one request succeed
Only permitted roles may reserve, pick, capture delivery or decide a substitution
Picking is a physical observation bounded by its confirmed reservation
Staging is its own observation and cannot exceed the picked quantity
A short pick needs a recorded finding and blocks dispatch readiness until reviewed
Reviewing a finding records an outcome without altering the physical observation
A substitution is a proposal only, requires two independent positions and never changes the order
A prepared dispatch moves nothing and cannot exceed the uncommitted staged quantity
Issuing a pick list or packing document never dispatches goods
Physical dispatch, source shipment and delivery are three separate records
Delivery capture records received quantities against exact source lines and cannot exceed the consignment
An acknowledgement names its exact delivery and quantities and excludes wider acceptance
The retained shortage is owned, and the same impact identity cannot create a second obligation
Later confirmed supply is a refreshed observation with its own receipt evidence
The second shipment completes the line and quantity conservation holds in the declared unit
The original shortage history and both shipments remain visible after completion
A correction supersedes its predecessor instead of overwriting or double counting it
A failed delivery attempt records no received quantity and is retained
An unknown source outcome blocks further effect until the original operation is reconciled
An identical operation identity replays once; different content under the same identity is refused
A stale session version or a stale source snapshot retains the original state
Changing an expected date does not replace the confirmed commitment
Changing a confirmed commitment retains the earlier version, needs a review role and reschedules nothing
Recovery matters are routed, not rebuilt, and retain their resolution evidence here
Quantity parsing rejects invalid precision, negatives and non-numeric entries
A malformed saved session is refused and a valid one round-trips without loss
Every recorded command produced exactly one receipt and one history entry
